translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

book.name: 1 TESALONAIKA
book.title: Folo yana leta nagona TESALONAIKA tovetumagana agaidiya

content: Tobohiyameyao, keke buye kadavemagigiꞋitaꞋita faꞋina, ime amaꞋitoto aꞋaseꞋuꞋaulolo. E, aseꞋasema giꞋuꞋaulolo-moꞋa againe agahe agayo, “AmaꞋiselu-moꞋa Adenisi againe anamiyami tu Timoti ginana.”

Au tobohiyama Timoti agaimiya aꞋiveninisena, banaꞋe Yaubada buye hifififaisewa be VenuwaꞋata Yamumuna Keliso faꞋine gilulumamalena. E, tobohiyama aꞋiveninisena be Keliso ana vetumagana againe ginakivetoyogimi, kadu ginaluꞋageyemi higa vaita vita tulina tulina kaliva nimadiya wanuhagana faꞋina keke wananuwayewa. Omi taumiyao ahe wahalamane-hagihagiyena mena vitai-dina Yaubada yana vehimeya againe ide agaideya gilakayemu.
Ika, boi aimo buye kamiyami ana toveya avenuwaꞋata-vagahimi vaita kaliva hinakivekoyoda. Ada taumadi wahalamanena medede amine gilakayemu.

Ada vitai-dina wanuhagana faꞋina aseꞋaseku giꞋuꞋaulolo-moꞋa againe, Timoti gaꞋiveninisena be higa yami vetumagana valeyana gananogalina. Gamatauta kaꞋi Setani tamo gavadi againe gidaꞋaladibidibiyemi ada au yama faisewa guwana gidaluyaweyawelina.
MiTesalonaika valeyadi yamumuna Folo ginogalina faꞋina,

Tu Timoti agaimiya gitauya be ime agaimeya giyewana ada valeyami yamumuna giꞋaliyena, higa yami wavetumagana yami wahawahega wamimiyami. Gigahema vaita tova moyaꞋaina waduꞋuduꞋuma kadu ime nuwanuwama omi anaꞋitami amine meda omi nuwanuwami ime wanaꞋitama.
Tu tobohiyameyao, yama aseꞋuꞋaulolo kadu ama vita tulina tulina agaidiya omi faꞋimiya aseꞋasema givatu. E, yami vetumagana faꞋina aꞋasevatu.
KaꞋi omi Kaiwabu againe wanavetumagana toyogina be keke maꞋita wananuwayewa amine o, ime wayawaima hagihagina anamiyami.
Omi faꞋimiya Yaubada againe avesivesiule. Yama vemwamwala lakahina omi faꞋimiya givelema ada Bana matane avemwamwala-moꞋa. Yada Yaubada keke kanawona!
Bogi be uyadayada Yaubada againe aꞋawalulauꞋu higa vaita buye kanavemagigiꞋitaꞋita ada gavaimi yami vetumagana againe wakaliꞋuho, medema againe anavelugami be yami vetumagana ginatubuga-moꞋa.
Tu aveꞋoꞋola be Yaubada Tamada Tauna kadu yada Kaiwabu Yesu yama eda hinaꞋivetuvetununa be agaimiya anaꞋela.

Kaiwabu Yesu againe aveꞋoꞋola be yami veꞋahawahawahega kadu yami nuwanuwa hawahawahegana kaliva moyaꞋaidi agaidiya ginatubutubuga ginatubutubuga tu nuwanuwa hawahawahegana againe wanawahivemavemauga. Omi ami nuwakabubu againe ime awahivemavemauga amine, meda omi veꞋanuwakabubu againe wanawahivemavemauga.

Kadu yada Yaubada ginafaiwalavelemi be aimo yada Kaiwabu Yesu ginayewaꞋela ana toveya yana kaliva mahamahalidiyao buyeꞋi, kadu omi mahamahalimiyao keke tamo yami wakoyona Yaubada Tamada matane wanamiyami.
